project_type: Next.js 14 App Router frontend + FastAPI backend (MongoDB/Redis)
build_system: Next.js 14 with App Router — standard npm scripts in frontend/
test_framework: No frontend test framework configured. Backend: pytest (python -m pytest -q in backend/)
test_command: cd frontend && npm run build && npm run lint
verification_instructions: 1. Run `cd frontend && npm run build` — must complete with no TypeScript errors. 2. Run `npm run lint` — no lint errors. 3. Smoke-test by running `npm run dev` and manually verifying all routes load.
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend/.next/ is generated — never commit it. Run `npm run build` to regenerate.
environment_constraints: Windows (PowerShell/bash). Node.js must be available. Backend runs on http://localhost:8000. Frontend dev server on http://localhost:3000. NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE env var controls the API base URL.
contribution_requirements: All prices are in integer paise (never float). Never expose provider names (ElevenLabs, Sarvam, Exotel, etc.) to customers. All API calls use JWT Bearer token from localStorage. Pagination uses skip/limit params. Do not duplicate files — check existing ones before creating.
key_patterns: Backend routes are all under /api/v1/. JWT token stored in localStorage key 'access_token'. Refresh token in 'refresh_token'. Route groups: (auth) for login/signup, (dashboard) for customer pages, (admin) for super-admin. The existing frontend is a dark real-estate demo — completely replace it. Keep existing package.json dependencies; add react-hot-toast (already present) for toasts. Use clsx + tailwind-merge (already in package.json) for conditional classes. Use Recharts (already in package.json) for charts. Use @tanstack/react-table (already in package.json) for tables. Use lucide-react for icons (already in package.json). Use date-fns for date formatting (already in package.json).
directory_structure: frontend/ — Next.js 14 App Router. frontend/app/ — all pages. frontend/components/ — shared components. frontend/lib/ — API client and utilities. frontend/app/(auth)/ — login/signup pages (no sidebar). frontend/app/(dashboard)/ — customer authenticated pages (with sidebar). frontend/app/(admin)/ — super admin pages (admin sidebar). backend/ — FastAPI. backend/api/v1/ — all REST endpoints. backend/models/ — MongoDB document schemas. backend/services/ — business logic. backend/repositories/ — data access.
